chunks: My father (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Abdullah ibn Jafar narrated to me from Harun ibn Muslim from Masada ibn Sadaqa from Jafar ibn Muhammad from his forefathers (peace be upon them). The Prophet (may God bless him and his family) said:

Whoever sees a Jew, a Christian, a Zoroastrian, or anyone who is not upon the religion of Islam and says: 'Praise be to God who preferred me over you with Islam as a religion, the Quran as a Book, Muhammad as a prophet, Ali as an Imam, the believers as brethren, and the Ka’ba as a qibla' -- then God will never gather him with that person in the Fire.

key_terms.إِمَام: Imam - the divinely appointed leader and guide of the Muslim community after the Prophet
key_terms.قِبْلَة: Qibla - the direction of prayer, physically embodied by the Ka’ba in Mecca
key_terms.مِلَّة: Milla - religious path or creed, referring to the overall religious tradition one follows

ai.seo_question: What should a Muslim say when seeing a person of another faith according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) teaches that whoever sees a non-Muslim and expresses gratitude to God for six blessings -- Islam as a religion, the Quran as a Book, Muhammad as a prophet, Ali as an Imam, the believers as brethren, and the Ka’ba as a qibla -- will never be gathered with that person in the Hellfire. This hadith emphasizes that the appropriate response to encountering people of other faiths is personal gratitude for one’s own blessings, not hostility.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Ja`far narrated to me from Harun b. Muslim from Mas`ada b. Sadaqa from Ja`far b. Muhammad from his forefathers (as). The Prophet (s) said:

Whoever sees a Jew, Christian, Zoroastrian, or anyone who is not upon the way of Islam and says: “Praise be to Allah who preferred me over you with Islam as a religion, the Quran as a Book, Muhammad as a prophet, `Ali as an Imam, the believers as brethren, and the Ka`ba as a qibla (alhamdulillahil lathi fadalani `alayka bil islami dinan wa bil qur’ani kitaban wa bi muhammadan nabiyyan wa bi `aliyyin imaman wa bil mu’minina ikhwanan wa bil ka`bati qiblata)”, then Allah will never gather him with him in the Fire.
